sources.title: Ismail Qemali: Shqiptari se ka zakon ta shesë shqiptarin
sources.supports: Secondary identification of the matching confrontation as a scene from Nëntori i dytë, not proof of historical dialogue.

visualMethod: Two qualitative card diagrams: sourced dates distinguishing historical setting, film production and restoration; original editorial questions about keeping one’s word. No quantities or historical causal claims are inferred.

meaningEvidence: The submitted original MP4 was recovered and its SHA-256 exactly matches the approved source mapping for the verified native TikTok publication.

Full Albanian audio transcribed locally; sampled original frames show a costumed horseback confrontation. Dialogue names Ismail Bej and Ismail Qemali and discusses joining him, punishment and independence.
Actual publication caption explicitly calls this a film excerpt and frames it through besa, dignity, conscience and facing fear.

AQSHF confirms the feature film and historical setting; the Albanian Cinema Project confirms production/restoration context; the exact confrontation is also identified in a dated InfoShqip scene article.
limitations: This is a dramatic portrayal, not contemporary protest footage or a primary recording of the 1912 conversation.
Some automatic transcript wording is noisy; only the short line independently present in the original caption is quoted, once in Albanian.
No claim is made that this particular social excerpt is drawn from the restored print or that Eduard created the underlying film.
The political and ethical reading is Eduard-caption-grounded commentary; historical fidelity of every scene is not established.
